struct.name: r
struct.note: The red channel of the default primitive colour.

struct.name: g
struct.note: The green channel of the default primitive colour.

struct.name: b
struct.note: The blue channel of the default primitive colour.

struct.name: min_looping_seconds
struct.note: The minimum looping time. When both the minimum and maximum are 255, the animation loops forever.

struct.name: replay_delay
struct.note: The delay before the animation replays.

ACTI.name: Active
ACTI.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/ACTI. [measured: 5,612 unknown ACTI subrecords in Skyrim.esm before this definition]

OBND.name: Object Bounds
OBND.note: Always 12 bytes, even when all zero.

FULL.name: Full Name
FULL.note: The name shown in the game.

MODL.name: Model
MODL.note: The model, with the MODB, MODT, MODS and MODD fields.

DEST.name: Destruction Data
DEST.note: The destructible object data, with the DSTD, DMDL, DMDT, DMDS and DSTF fields.

KWDA.name: Keyword
KWDA.note: A KYWD record. There is one per KSIZ.

SNAM.name: Sound Looping
SNAM.note: An SNDR record played in a loop.

VNAM.name: Sound Activation
VNAM.note: An SNDR record played on activation.

RNAM.name: Activate Text Override
RNAM.note: A custom verb shown in the game when the activator is targeted, such as Mine or Place.

FNAM.name: Flags
FNAM.note: 0x01 = No Displacement, which goes with the water type. 0x02 = Ignored by Sandbox. The other bits appear in the record header.

KNAM.name: Interaction Keyword
KNAM.note: A KYWD record used for interaction purposes.

IDLE.name: Idle Animation
IDLE.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/IDLE. [measured: 2,656 DNAM fields in Skyrim.esm]

CTDA.name: Conditions
CTDA.note: The conditions under which the animation plays.

ENAM.name: Anim Event
ENAM.note: The event, for example HorseExitSwim or NPCshoutStart.

ANAM.name: Animations
ANAM.note: The parent — an IDLE formid, or an AACT for a true root — and the previous IDLE.

DATA.name: Data
DATA.note: The animation's looping times, flags and replay delay.

SMQN.name: Quest Node
SMQN.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/SMQN. A quest node is a tree of events, each with its own conditions and the quests it belongs to. [measured: 4,377 unknown SMQN subrecords in Skyrim.esm before this definition]

PNAM.name: Parent
PNAM.note: The parent SMQN, SMBN or SMEN.

SNAM.name: Sibling
SNAM.note: Zero for the first child, or the prior sibling.

CIS2.name: Variable Name
CIS2.note: An optional variable name, for example "::playerAllegiance_var".

DNAM.name: Flags
DNAM.note: The event's flags. 0x01 is known, and very large values such as 0x10000 and 0x100000 occur.

NNAM.name: Quest Node
NNAM.note: A QUST formid. There is one per QNAM, each optionally followed by an RNAM.

RNAM.name: Reset Time
RNAM.note: The time until the reset. The CK shows the value divided by 24 and labelled as hours, which is probably days.

WTHR.name: Weather
WTHR.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/WTHR. [measured: 6,768 TNAM fields in Skyrim.esm]

LNAM.name: Texture Layer Count
LNAM.note: How many texture layers the clouds have. It is always 0x04 or 0x1d.

RNAM.name: Cloud Speed Y
RNAM.note: 32 bytes, one per layer. The byte for layer n is a float encoded as a uint8, where 0x00 is -0.1, 0x7f is 0 and 0xfe is 0.1.

QNAM.name: Cloud Speed X
QNAM.note: 32 bytes, one per layer, encoded as the cloud speed Y is.

PNAM.name: Cloud Texture Color
PNAM.note: 512 bytes: 32 structs of 16 bytes, one per layer, each with the sunrise, day, sunset and night colours.

JNAM.name: Cloud Texture Alpha
JNAM.note: 512 bytes: 32 structs of 16 bytes, one per layer, each with the sunrise, day, sunset and night alphas.

NAM0.name: Colours
NAM0.note: 208, 224 or 272 bytes of 16-byte structs, each with the sunrise, day, sunset and night colours. The n-th struct is the sky upper, fog near, a layer that seems to be ignored, ambient, sunlight, sun, stars, sky lower, horizon, effect lightning, cloud LOD diffuse, cloud LOD ambient, fog far, and others.
